title: Does Your Generalist Skill Optimizer Really Incentivize Agentic Tasks? Rethinking Skill Optimization via Bipartite Attribution
title_zh: 你的通用技能优化器真的能激励智能体任务吗？通过二部归因重新思考技能优化

paragraphs.en: Skill optimizers adapt an agent to long-horizon tasks, such as repairing a terminal environment, by rewriting its skill, a natural-language procedure in its context, and keeping the edits that raise success on a small dev set. On such tasks success is noisy, so a gain on a small dev set does not show that an edit helps, and a success score does not show what the edit costs. We introduce BiPA, which replays an optimizer’s acceptance rule on candidates identical to its seed to measure what selection alone reports, and records each episode as a bipartite graph of turns and the text they read to trace extra input tokens to the behavior behind them. Across three optimizers, three agentic benchmarks and two models, the learned skills succeed about as often as their hand-written seed, 0.1 points higher on average. Their dev gains vanish on test: keeping the best of several candidates on at most 30 tasks reports gains this large even when none changed. They read about 16% more input tokens: the optimizers almost always add rules, half to re-check work and some to act one call at a time, and the agent follows them as extra turns, each re-sending the whole conversation. Four principles follow: accept an edit only if its gain exceeds what selection alone reports; charge it for the turns it adds, not for its length; let the editor delete and merge rules; show it what earlier rules cost. Code is available at https://github.com/valleysprings/BiPA.git .
paragraphs.zh: 技能优化器通过改写智能体的技能（即其上下文中一段自然语言描述的流程）来使智能体适应长程任务，例如修复终端环境，并保留那些能在小型开发集上提升成功率的修改。 在此类任务上成功带有噪声，因此在小型开发集上的提升并不能说明某项修改确有帮助，而成功分数也无法体现这项修改的代价。 我们提出 BiPA，它在与种子完全相同的候选上重放优化器的接受规则，以测量仅凭选择所能报告的结果，并将每个回合记录为由轮次及其读取的文本构成的二部图，从而将额外的输入 token 追溯到产生它们的背后行为。 在三个优化器、三个智能体基准和两个模型上，学习到的技能的成功率与手写种子大致相当，平均仅高 0.1 分。 它们在开发集上的提升在测试中消失：即使在毫无改动的情况下，仅凭在至多 30 个任务上保留若干候选中的最佳者，也能报告出如此规模的提升。 它们多读取约 16% 的输入 token：优化器几乎总是增加规则，其中一半用于复查已完成的工作，有些则要求每次调用只执行一步动作，而智能体会将这些规则转化为额外的轮次来执行，每一轮都重新发送完整对话。 由此得出四条原则：只有当修改的收益超过仅凭选择所能报告的水平时才接受它；按它增加的轮次而非其文本长度计费；允许编辑器删除和合并规则；向它展示先前规则付出的代价。 代码可在 https://github.com/valleysprings/BiPA.git 获取。

paragraphs.en: A harness , such as OpenCode or SWE-agent, is the agentic scaffold that runs a language model as an agent: it gives the model its prompt and tools and runs its loop until the task is done ( OpenCode contributors, 2025 ; Yang et al., 2024b ) . Built for software engineering, these harnesses now run agents on other long-horizon tasks, such as repairing a terminal environment, serving a customer or running a business workflow. An agent is adapted to a family of such tasks with a skill , a natural-language procedure that the harness places in the model’s context at the start of every task. Skill optimizers automate this, starting from a seed skill ( Agrawal et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ) : an editor model reads the trajectories , the logs of the agent’s runs on training tasks, and turns their successes and failures into rules, and a gate keeps an edit if the agent with the edited skill solves more tasks of a small development set, the dev set. These optimizers report gains, mostly on short, cheap tasks such as question answering, and controlled studies find the gains sparse and fragile ( Liu et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 运行框架（harness），例如 OpenCode 或 SWE-agent，是一种将语言模型作为智能体运行的智能体脚手架：它为模型提供提示词和工具，并运行其循环直到任务完成（OpenCode contributors, 2025；Yang et al., 2024b）。 这些为软件工程构建的运行框架，如今已能在其他长时程任务上运行智能体，例如修复终端环境、服务客户或运行业务工作流。 智能体通过技能（skill）适配到这样一族任务上：技能是一种自然语言程序，运行框架在每次任务开始时将其放入模型的上下文中。 技能优化器对此进行自动化，从种子技能出发（Agrawal et al., 2026；Yang et al., 2026；Li et al., 2026）：一个编辑器模型读取轨迹（即智能体在训练任务上运行的日志），将其成功与失败转化为规则，并且由一个门控判断：如果使用编辑后技能的智能体能在小型开发集（dev set）上解决更多任务，则保留该编辑。 这些优化器报告了收益，但主要集中在问答等短小、低成本的任务上，而受控研究发现这些收益稀疏且脆弱（Liu et al., 2026；Wang et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: Long-horizon tasks expose three gaps. First, selection is noisy. Long tasks keep dev sets small and success is stochastic, so one run can rank two skills either way ( Miller, 2024 ; Kapoor et al., 2025 ) , and keeping the best of several comparisons reports a gain even when nothing changed, a winner’s curse ( Smith and Winkler, 2006 ) : a reported gain does not show that a skill helps. Second, success hides cost. Each turn, one request to the model, re-sends the whole history, so extra turns raise the input tokens read over a task, and a success score does not show them. Third, rules go uncredited. The editor writes several rules per edit and the gate scores the whole edit with one number, so no rule is tested alone and it stays unknown which rules change the agent.
paragraphs.zh: 长程任务暴露出三个缺口。 第一，选择充满噪声。 长任务使开发集保持很小，且成功具有随机性，因此一次运行可能把两个技能排出任意一种高低次序（Miller, 2024；Kapoor et al., 2025），而且在多次比较中保留最佳结果，即使什么都没变也会报告出增益，这是一种赢家诅咒（Smith and Winkler, 2006）：报告的增益并不能表明某个技能确实有帮助。 第二，成功掩盖了成本。 每一轮都会向模型发送一次请求并重新发送全部历史记录，因此额外的轮次会增加一个任务中读取的输入 token 数量，而成功率并不能体现这一点。 第三，规则没有被单独评估。 编辑器在每次编辑时写入若干条规则，而门控用一个数字对整个编辑打分，因此没有哪条规则被单独测试，哪些规则改变了智能体也就始终不得而知。

paragraphs.en: We propose BiPA (Bipartite Attribution; Figure 1 ), which measures these gaps from the agent’s logs without changing the optimizer. For the first gap, it replays the optimizer’s acceptance rule on candidates identical to the seed, so any gain the rule reports comes from selection alone (Section 4.1 ). For the second, it records each attempt at a task as a bipartite graph between the agent’s turns and the text each turn reads (Section 4.2 ) and splits a rise in input tokens into more tool calls, the same calls over more turns, more text per turn and longer skill text (Sections 4.3 and 4.4 ). For the third, we sort each added rule into one of eight categories by what it asks the agent to do and compare the categories with the behavior the graph records (Section 5.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 BiPA（二部归因；图 1），它在不改变优化器的情况下，从智能体的日志中度量这些差距。 针对第一个差距，它在与种子完全相同的候选上重放优化器的接受规则，因此该规则所报告的任何收益都仅来自选择（第 4.1 节）。 针对第二个差距，它将每次任务尝试记录为智能体的轮次与每轮读取的文本之间的二部图（第 4.2 节），并将输入 token 的增长拆分为更多工具调用、相同调用分布在更多轮次、每轮更多文本以及更长的技能文本（第 4.3 节和第 4.4 节）。 针对第三个差距，我们按每条新增规则要求智能体做什么，将其归入八个类别之一，并将这些类别与图所记录的行为进行比较（第 5.3 节）。

paragraphs.en: We apply BiPA to GEPA, SkillOpt and SkillAdam on Terminal-Bench 2.1 (TB2), τ 3 \tau^{3} -bench and AutomationBench (AutoBench) with DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and GPT-6-Luna, and test transfer by running some of DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash’s skills under GPT-6-Luna or on another benchmark. All start from one seed, a generic hand-written procedure from a public repository that asks for a fresh, complete check before any claim of completion ( Vincent, 2025 ) .

The dev gains the optimizers report do not hold on test: the gate keeps the best of several candidates on a dev set of at most 30 tasks, where unchanged candidates would report gains of the same size. The edits grow the skill: 91 of 97 scored edits lengthen it, about half of the rules they add tell the agent to re-check its work and none to read less, and the agent carries these rules out as extra turns, each re-sending the whole conversation. The skills do not carry over to another model or benchmark, and most of their cost goes with them.

sents.zh: 这些技能无法迁移到另一个模型或基准，而且它们的大部分开销也随之而去。

paragraphs.en: We formulate BiPA, which dissects skill optimization without changing the optimizer: a selection replay gives the dev gain that selection alone reports, and a bipartite graph of turns and context traces each extra input token to the behavior behind it (Sections 4.1 to 4.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 BiPA，它在不改变优化器的情况下剖析技能优化：一次选择回放给出仅由选择所报告的开发增益，而一个由回合和上下文构成的二分图将每个额外的输入词元追溯到其背后的行为（第 4.1 至 4.4 节）。

paragraphs.en: Based on BiPA, we show why learned skills do not pay off: selection alone can produce their dev gains, and their rules add turns that each re-send the whole conversation, a cost that, unlike the gain, travels with the skill to other models and benchmarks.
paragraphs.zh: 基于 BiPA，我们说明了为什么学习到的技能没有带来收益：仅凭选择就能复现其开发集收益，而其规则会增加回合数，每个回合都要重新发送整个对话；这一成本与收益不同，会随技能一同迁移到其他模型和基准上。

paragraphs.en: Based on this mechanism, we propose four design principles for skill optimizers (Section 6 ): accept an edit only if its gain exceeds what selection alone reports; charge it for the turns it adds, not for its length; let the editor delete and merge rules; and show it what its earlier rules cost.
paragraphs.zh: 基于这一机制，我们为技能优化器提出四条设计原则（第 6 节）：仅当某次编辑的收益超过仅凭选择所报告的收益时才接受它；按其增加的轮次而非其长度来计费；允许编辑器删除并合并规则；并向它展示其早期规则的代价。

paragraphs.en: Prompt optimizers let a language model edit scored prompts or follow textual feedback or evolutionary search ( Zhou et al., 2023 ; Yang et al., 2024a ; Yuksekgonul et al., 2025 ; Guo et al., 2024 ) ; GEPA has a model reflect on the logs of its runs and draws the skill to edit from the skills that are best on at least one dev task ( Agrawal et al., 2026 ) . Skill optimizers apply this loop to the procedures an agent harness loads: SkillOpt accepts edits of limited size that raise dev success ( Yang et al., 2026 ) , SkillAdam adapts its edit size ( Li et al., 2026 ) , and EvoSkill keeps a skill when it raises held-out success ( Alzubi et al., 2026 ) ; Trace2Skill and experience memories distill skills or playbooks from trajectories ( Ni et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) ; all learn from task outcomes.

paragraphs.en: A few optimizers make cost a goal: CAPO penalizes prompt length and MO-CAPO the input and output tokens of inference ( Zehle et al., 2025 ; Büssing et al., 2026 ) , SkillMOO searches for skills that are best on pass rate and cost together ( Gong et al., 2026 ) , SkillReducer and SkillZip Pro compress skill text ( Gao et al., 2026 ; Bai et al., 2026b ) , and cost-aware rewriting finds that shorter skills can cost more ( Xing et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 少数优化器将成本作为目标：CAPO 对提示词长度进行惩罚，MO-CAPO 对推理的输入和输出 token 进行惩罚（Zehle et al., 2025；Büssing et al., 2026），SkillMOO 同时搜索在通过率和成本上表现最佳的技能（Gong et al., 2026），SkillReducer 和 SkillZip Pro 压缩技能文本（Gao et al., 2026；Bai et al., 2026b），而成本感知改写发现更短的技能可能成本更高（Xing et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: Controlled studies find that skill evolution is sparse and filtered by validation, with validation and test sometimes favoring different feedback ( Liu et al., 2026 ) ; that on Terminal-Bench 2.1 harness evolution gains little on held-out tasks and does not beat simply running the agent more times at the same budget, while on long-horizon games it beats a search baseline ( Wang et al., 2026 ) ; and that writing a harness update differs from benefiting from it ( Lin et al., 2026 ) . Each measures success; BiPA also measures what a skill changes in the agent.

paragraphs.en: Agents of similar accuracy differ widely in cost ( Kapoor et al., 2025 ; Kapoor et al., 2026 ) . In agentic coding, input tokens drive the cost and vary from run to run ( Bai et al., 2026a ) , and cutting tokens need not cut cost, because it changes the trajectory ( Weinberger and Hozez, 2026 ) . paragraphs.en: We ask two questions of a learned skill against its seed: (i) does it succeed more often, that is, does its test gain exceed the spread of the seed’s own test runs, and does its dev gain G G exceed what selection alone reports; and (ii) which content and which behavior make up its extra input tokens, L ⁡ ( S ) L(S) .

paragraphs.en: How the margins add up depends on the gate. A gate that scores every kept skill on one fixed dev set, as SkillOpt and GEPA do, lets the scores in between cancel, so G G is the returned skill’s dev score minus the seed’s starting score , the dev score the run starts from. A gate that scores each step on a small batch, where a task is worth more points, and rescores the kept skill at the next step, as SkillAdam does, does not let the scores cancel, so the sum keeps every lucky win.
paragraphs.zh: 边际收益如何累加取决于闸门。 像 SkillOpt 和 GEPA 那样在一个固定的开发集上对每个保留的技能打分的闸门，会让中间的分数相互抵消，因此 G G 是返回技能的开发集分数减去种子的起始分数，即整个运行开始时的开发集分数。 像 SkillAdam 那样在每一步用一个小批量（其中每个任务占更多分值）打分、并在下一步对保留的技能重新打分的闸门，不会让分数相互抵消，因此累加会保留每一次侥幸的得分。

paragraphs.en: We ask three research questions about skills on the model and benchmark they were learned on. RQ1 : Do learned skills succeed more often than the seed? RQ2 : What do learned skills change in the agent’s behavior, and what does that cost? RQ3 : What in the optimizers’ edits produces these changes? Section 5.2 answers RQ1 and RQ2 and tests whether the skills transfer to another model or benchmark; Section 5.3 answers RQ3 and traces RQ2’s cost to its source.

paragraphs.en: We run three published general skill optimizers (Appendix A ). GEPA ( Agrawal et al., 2026 ) has its editor rewrite a parent after reading the trajectories of a batch of 8 training tasks (its default is 3) and scores a candidate on the whole dev set if it beats its parent on that batch. SkillOpt ( Yang et al., 2026 ) keeps a candidate whose score on the whole dev set is strictly above the current skill’s. SkillAdam ( Li et al., 2026 ) proposes small edits and keeps one only if it beats the current skill on 10 dev tasks drawn anew at each step; TB2 reuses the same 9. Under GPT-6-Luna, SkillAdam’s gate uses the 10 training tasks its editor read in place of these dev tasks. They share one seed, verification-before-completion ( Vincent, 2025 ) (Appendix G.2 ); one sample of 160 training episodes per benchmark, from which they draw their training batches; and one dev set of 30 tasks (9 on TB2).
paragraphs.zh: 我们运行了三个已发表的通用技能优化器（附录 A）。 GEPA（Agrawal 等人，2026）的编辑器在阅读一批 8 个训练任务（其默认值为 3）的轨迹后重写父技能，并且如果候选技能在该批次上胜过父技能，则在整个开发集上对其进行评分。 SkillOpt（Yang 等人，2026）会保留在整个开发集上的得分严格高于当前技能的候选技能。 SkillAdam（Li 等人，2026）提出小的修改，并且只有当它在每次步骤中新抽取的 10 个开发任务上胜过当前技能时才保留该修改；TB2 复用同样的 9 个。 在 GPT-6-Luna 下，SkillAdam 的门控使用其编辑器读取的 10 个训练任务来替代这些开发任务。 它们共享同一个种子、完成前验证（Vincent，2025）（附录 G.2）；每个基准测试 160 个训练回合的同一个样本，优化器从中抽取训练批次；以及一个包含 30 个任务的开发集（TB2 上为 9 个）。

paragraphs.en: Under DeepSeek, SkillOpt and GEPA reported dev gains of 3 to 17 points, and SkillAdam 20 to 40, summed over small dev batches (Section 4.1 ). Unchanged candidates reach each of the nine reported gains with probability 0.25 to 0.94 (Figure 3 a), and test does not follow the gains (Figure 3 b): along the path of skills each τ 3 \tau^{3} -bench run kept in turn, tested once on an updated DeepSeek release, the dev gain climbs 6.7 points after the first kept skill while the test difference stays within 2.7 points of its value there (Figure 9 , Appendix 9 ). Every DeepSeek SkillOpt and GEPA run measures its gain against the seed’s lowest-scoring dev run, one of two or three, its starting score, and keeps the best of 4 to 8 candidates on a dev set of at most 30 tasks. A gate that accepts any candidate that outscores its parent in one dev run accepts an unchanged candidate 24 to 41% of the time, and replaying each optimizer’s acceptance rule when every candidate is unchanged, that is, the seed scored again, reaches the reported gains with probability 0.56 to 0.94 for SkillOpt and GEPA under DeepSeek and 0.21 to 0.99 under Luna. Task by task, the ten SkillOpt and GEPA skills newly solve 12.5% of the dev tasks and newly fail 2.7%, but on test 8.9% and 6.9%, close to the 1.9 to 7.8% of tasks on which two test runs of the seed itself differ in each direction, except Luna on AutoBench, where the learned skills gain on test although their dev scores hardly moved (Appendix C.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在 DeepSeek 下，SkillOpt 与 GEPA 在小规模开发集批次上累计报告了 3 到 17 分的开发集提升，SkillAdam 为 20 到 40 分（第 4.1 节）。 若候选不变，达到九项报告提升中每一项的概率为 0.25 到 0.94（图 3a），且测试并不跟随开发集提升（图 3b）：在 τ^3-bench 依次保留的技能路径上，每次在更新版 DeepSeek 上测试一次，保留第一个技能后开发集提升攀升 6.7 分，而测试差异仍在其该处数值的 2.7 分以内（图 9，附录 9）。 每次在 DeepSeek 上的 SkillOpt 与 GEPA 运行，其提升都以种子的最低开发集得分为基准——该种子仅运行两到三次，取其中最低分作为起始分——并在最多 30 个任务的开发集上保留 4 到 8 个候选中的最佳者。 一个接受在任何一次开发集运行中得分超过父代的候选的门控，会有 24% 到 41% 的概率接受未变化的候选；而在所有候选均未变化（即种子重新评分）时重放各优化器的接受规则，达到报告提升的概率在 DeepSeek 下 SkillOpt 与 GEPA 为 0.56 到 0.94，在 Luna 下为 0.21 到 0.99。 逐任务来看，十个 SkillOpt 与 GEPA 技能新解出 12.5% 的开发集任务、新使 2.7% 失败，但在测试集上分别为 8.9% 与 6.9%，接近种子自身两次测试运行在两个方向上产生差异的 1.9% 到 7.8% 的任务比例，唯一例外是 Luna 在 AutoBench 上：所学技能在测试集上有所提升，而其开发集得分几乎没有变化（附录 C.3）。

sents.en: A gate that accepts any candidate that outscores its parent in one dev run accepts an unchanged candidate 24 to 41% of the time, and replaying each optimizer’s acceptance rule when every candidate is unchanged, that is, the seed scored again, reaches the reported gains with probability 0.56 to 0.94 for SkillOpt and GEPA under DeepSeek and 0.21 to 0.99 under Luna.
sents.zh: 一个接受在任何一次开发集运行中得分超过父代的候选的门控，会有 24% 到 41% 的概率接受未变化的候选；而在所有候选均未变化（即种子重新评分）时重放各优化器的接受规则，达到报告提升的概率在 DeepSeek 下 SkillOpt 与 GEPA 为 0.56 到 0.94，在 Luna 下为 0.21 到 0.99。

sents.en: Task by task, the ten SkillOpt and GEPA skills newly solve 12.5% of the dev tasks and newly fail 2.7%, but on test 8.9% and 6.9%, close to the 1.9 to 7.8% of tasks on which two test runs of the seed itself differ in each direction, except Luna on AutoBench, where the learned skills gain on test although their dev scores hardly moved (Appendix C.3 ).
sents.zh: 逐任务来看，十个 SkillOpt 与 GEPA 技能新解出 12.5% 的开发集任务、新使 2.7% 失败，但在测试集上分别为 8.9% 与 6.9%，接近种子自身两次测试运行在两个方向上产生差异的 1.9% 到 7.8% 的任务比例，唯一例外是 Luna 在 AutoBench 上：所学技能在测试集上有所提升，而其开发集得分几乎没有变化（附录 C.3）。

paragraphs.en: An agent covers a task if one of its three test runs solves it; a skill expands the agent if it covers tasks the agent did not, and sharpens it if it solves more often, with more similar tool sequences, tasks the agent already solved sometimes. Over the six model–benchmark pairs with learned skills, the seed covers 36 tasks that the no-skill agent does not and misses 13 that it covers, while the learned skills, summed over the three optimizers, cover 57 tasks that the seed does not and lose 62 that it covers. Where they gain, a task’s three episodes agree more: tool sequences more alike than under the seed for 68% of the tasks whose success rose, against 49% of the unchanged (Appendix F.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 若智能体的三次测试运行中有一次解决了某任务，则称该智能体覆盖该任务；若一项技能使智能体覆盖了其原本未能覆盖的任务，则称该技能扩展了智能体；若该技能使智能体在解决其原本有时能解决的任务时更频繁成功、且工具序列更加相似，则称该技能精炼了智能体。 在六个「模型–基准」组合中（均使用学到的技能），种子智能体覆盖了无技能智能体未覆盖的 36 个任务，却遗漏了后者覆盖的 13 个任务；而将三种优化器学到的技能汇总来看，它们覆盖了种子智能体未覆盖的 57 个任务，却失去了种子智能体覆盖的 62 个任务。 在技能带来提升之处，同一任务的三次运行结果更为一致：在成功率上升的任务中，有 68% 的任务的工具序列比种子智能体下更相似，而在成功率不变的任务中该比例为 49%（附录 F.2）。

paragraphs.en: One chain, from the editor through the agent to the harness, produces the extra cost. The gate scores a whole edit on at most 30 tasks and cannot credit a single rule, so the rules the editor writes accumulate.
paragraphs.zh: 从编辑器经智能体到执行框架的同一条链路产生了额外成本。 该门控对整个编辑最多在 30 个任务上打分，无法归功于单条规则，因此编辑器编写的规则会不断累积。

paragraphs.en: A rule is one added bullet, numbered item, table row or example line; we sort each into one of eight categories by what it asks the agent to do, such as verify , re-check a result, or serialize , act one call at a time. Under DeepSeek the editor writes from small batches of training trajectories, an optimizer reads at most 160, yet a skill gains 37 rules on average, up to 105. Of the 59 DeepSeek edits scored on dev tasks whose parent the logs identify (38 under Luna), 58 lengthen the skill (33 under Luna); of the 337 rules they add (81 under Luna), none asks the agent to read less, half ask it to verify and 18 serialize (Appendix E.1 ). Nor does the gate filter cost: kept and rejected edits raise input tokens over their parents by about 10 and 14% on average.
paragraphs.zh: 一条规则是一个新增的项目符号、编号条目、表格行或示例行；我们按它要求智能体做什么，将其归入八个类别之一，例如验证（verify，复查某个结果）或串行化（serialize，一次只执行一次调用）。 在 DeepSeek 下，编辑器从少量训练轨迹批次中写作，优化器最多读取 160 条，但一项技能平均获得 37 条规则，最多达 105 条。 在开发任务上打分的 59 次 DeepSeek 编辑中（其父版本可由日志识别，其中 38 次在 Luna 下），58 次加长了技能（Luna 下为 33 次）；在它们新增的 337 条规则中（Luna 下为 81 条），没有一条要求智能体减少阅读，一半要求其进行验证，18 条要求串行化（附录 E.1）。 该门槛也不筛选成本：被保留和被拒绝的编辑使输入 token 相对其父版本平均增加约 10% 和 14%。

paragraphs.en: A repeated win approximates this: in simulation, requiring a dev win to repeat on a second dev run accepts 6 to 17% of unchanged candidates instead of 24 to 41%, and keeps 55 to 94% of edits that truly solve two more dev tasks (Figure 10 a). paragraphs.en: The three DeepSeek editors shorten the skill in 1 of 59 edits. Deleting the rules that split calls across turns would save less than it seems: recomputed with the learned skills at the seed’s calls per turn, AutoBench’s log ⁡ ρ \log\rho would halve, from 0.17 to 0.08 (Figure 10 c), but most of that comes from writes the rules serialize so that two writes in one turn cannot overwrite each other (Appendix E.2 ). The editor also needs to write rules aimed at the costs that serialized writes do not explain: batch the independent reads that remain sequential, worth about one turn per episode, and return from each call only what the next turn needs.
paragraphs.zh: 三位 DeepSeek 编辑者在 59 次修改中有 1 次缩短了技能。 删除那些把调用拆分到多个回合的规则，节省的效果没有看上去那么大：用学到的技能按种子的每回合调用数重新计算，AutoBench 的 log ⁡ ρ \log\rho 会减半，从 0.17 降到 0.08（图 10 c），但其中大部分来自这些规则将写入串行化，从而避免同一回合内的两次写入互相覆盖（附录 E.2 ）。 编辑者还需要针对串行化写入无法解释的成本编写规则：把仍然按顺序执行的独立读取改为批量执行，每个回合（episode）大约可省一个回合；并且每次调用只返回下一回合所需的内容。

paragraphs.en: Measured with BiPA, the skills learned by GEPA, SkillOpt and SkillAdam sharpen the agent’s behavior; they do not expand it. Over all sixteen learned skills of both models, test success is 0.1 points above the seed’s; the skills cover about as many new tasks as they lose, make a task’s episodes agree more where they gain, and read 1.16 times the seed’s input tokens, over more turns. Selection alone can produce the dev gains the optimizers report, and the skills do not carry over to another model or benchmark, while most of their cost does. One causal chain explains the extra cost: on small dev sets the gate cannot credit single rules, so the rules the editor writes accumulate; the agent carries their checks out as extra turns; and input tokens grow faster than turns, because the harness re-sends the history. Four design principles follow (Section 6 ); and to expand what an agent solves, an optimizer would need to reward coverage, the tasks solved in at least one of several episodes.
paragraphs.zh: 用 BiPA 测量发现，GEPA、SkillOpt 和 SkillAdam 学到的技能使智能体的行为变得更尖锐，而非更扩展。 在两个模型学到的全部十六项技能上，测试成功率仅比种子高 0.1 分；这些技能新增的任务与丢失的任务大致相当，在有所提升的任务上使各次回合的结果更加一致，并以种子 1.16 倍的输入 token 数、在更多的轮次上运行。 仅凭选择就能产生这些优化器所报告的开发集收益，而这些技能无法迁移到另一个模型或基准上，但其大部分成本却会随之保留。 一条因果链解释了额外的成本：在小的开发集上，门控无法为单条规则记功，因此编辑器写下的规则不断累积；智能体把这些检查作为额外轮次来执行；又因为框架会重发历史记录，输入 token 的增长快于轮次的增长。 由此得出四条设计原则（第 6 节）；而要扩展智能体能解决的问题，优化器需要奖励覆盖率，即在若干次回合中至少有一次解出的任务。

paragraphs.en: BiPA is a measurement instrument. We apply it to three published skill optimizers from one shared seed, so that their edits can be compared line by line, with two models in one harness on three benchmarks of long-horizon tasks; it applies unchanged to other optimizers, seeds, models, harnesses and task families. Three limits concern the instrument and one the optimizers it measures.
paragraphs.zh: BiPA 是一种测量工具。 我们将其应用于三个已发表的技能优化器，从一个共享种子出发，使它们的编辑可以逐行比较；在一个评测框架中使用两个模型，在三个长程任务基准上进行测试；该方法无需修改即可应用于其他优化器、种子、模型、评测框架和任务族。 其中三个局限涉及测量工具本身，一个涉及它所测量的优化器。

paragraphs.en: BiPA measures what a learned skill changed once its episodes are recorded: it attributes a change in input tokens to the behaviors that carry it, and a change in success to what selection alone reports, under the assumptions stated in Appendix C.1 . It does not predict which rule will add turns, and it does not explain why the model chooses a behavior; the link from a rule to the behavior it causes rests here on the edits the optimizers made and on matching rules to the behavior they name, such as serialized writes. Controlled rewrites of single rules would test this link causally, and a model of it would let an optimizer estimate an edit’s cost before running it.
paragraphs.zh: BiPA 衡量的是在某个技能的回合被记录之后，习得的技能改变了什么：在附录 C.1 所述的假设下，它将输入词元的变化归因于承载这些变化的行为，而将成功的变化归因于仅由选择所反映的内容。 它不预测哪条规则会增加回合数，也不解释模型为何选择某个行为；从规则到其引发的行为之间的联系，在这里依赖于优化器所做的编辑，以及将规则与它们所命名的行为（如串行化写入）相匹配。 对单条规则进行受控改写可以对这一联系进行因果检验，而对该联系建立模型则能让优化器在运行编辑之前估计其代价。

paragraphs.en: The turn elasticity is derived for a harness that re-sends its history, as OpenCode does in our runs. For harnesses that compact or summarize their history, or bill cached history at a discount, the bipartite graph and the four-term split still apply, but the turn elasticity has to be measured from their episodes; our re-billing of the recorded episodes under a compacted history, with the agent’s turns held fixed, is a first step.
paragraphs.zh: 轮次弹性是针对会重发其历史记录的 harness 推导出来的，正如 OpenCode 在我们的运行中所做的那样。 对于会压缩或摘要其历史记录、或对缓存历史按折扣计费的 harness，二部图和四项分解仍然适用，但轮次弹性必须从它们的 episode 中测量；在智能体的轮次保持不变的情况下，对已记录的 episode 在压缩历史下重新计费，是迈出的第一步。

paragraphs.en: BiPA decomposes cost because input tokens and tool calls add up over turns and context components. Success does not: it is scored once, at the end of an episode, and splitting it over turns, components or rules needs a value function over the agent’s states. Behind a black-box model API the model’s state is not observable, so no such value function can be defined, let alone decomposed. This is the credit a gate would need to judge single rules, and the most important extension of BiPA.
paragraphs.zh: BiPA 之所以难以分解成本，是因为输入 token 和工具调用会随着回合与上下文组成部分不断累加。 成功则不然：它只在回合结束时评分一次，若要将其分摊到各个回合、组成部分或规则上，需要一个基于智能体状态的价值函数。 在黑盒模型 API 背后，模型的状态不可观测，因此无法定义这样的价值函数，更谈不上分解。 这正是门控判断单条规则所需的信用信号，也是 BiPA 最重要的扩展方向。

paragraphs.en: What separates these optimizers from recursive self-improvement (RSI) is not which artifact they optimize, a skill, a harness or a model, but whether the optimizer itself improves. An external optimizer does not solve tasks; its job is to make the agent better. Improving it continually means making “improve the agent, starting from a given agent” its training task, rather than training on ordinary task scores. Today’s skill, harness and model optimizers are static propose-verify-accept loops: a fixed procedure proposes a change, scores it on tasks and keeps or discards it, and optimizing several artifacts together is still such a loop. BiPA measures these loops and extends to harness and model optimizers, but they are not RSI. RSI needs every link of the chain to keep improving: the agent, the optimizer that improves it, and whatever improves that optimizer.
paragraphs.zh: 这些优化器与递归自我改进（RSI）的区别不在于它们优化的对象是什么——技能、脚手架还是模型，而在于优化器本身是否也在改进。 外部优化器并不直接解决任务；它的职责是让智能体变得更好。 持续改进它，意味着把“从一个给定的智能体出发改进智能体”作为它的训练任务，而不是在普通任务得分上进行训练。 今天的技能、脚手架和模型优化器都是静态的“提议—验证—接受”循环：一个固定的流程提出一项改动，在任务上为其打分，然后保留或丢弃它，而同时优化多个工件也仍然是这样一个循环。 BiPA 度量了这些循环，并扩展到脚手架和模型优化器，但它们还不是 RSI。 RSI 需要链条上的每一环都持续改进：智能体本身、改进智能体的优化器，以及任何改进该优化器的东西。

sents.zh: 今天的技能、脚手架和模型优化器都是静态的“提议—验证—接受”循环：一个固定的流程提出一项改动，在任务上为其打分，然后保留或丢弃它，而同时优化多个工件也仍然是这样一个循环。

sents.en: BiPA measures these loops and extends to harness and model optimizers, but they are not RSI.
sents.zh: BiPA 度量了这些循环，并扩展到脚手架和模型优化器，但它们还不是 RSI。

sents.en: RSI needs every link of the chain to keep improving: the agent, the optimizer that improves it, and whatever improves that optimizer.
sents.zh: RSI 需要链条上的每一环都持续改进：智能体本身、改进智能体的优化器，以及任何改进该优化器的东西。

paragraphs.en: Our baselines are the three published optimizers, each running its released code (Appendix G.1 gives the text we fill into their prompts). Each keeps or rejects candidates by success alone and returns a skill chosen on dev or training-batch scores, never test (SkillOpt’s upstream loop also scores three skills on test; these scores select nothing). All three take their training batches in a fixed order from one shared sample of 160 training episodes (on TB2, three reshuffled passes over the 62 training tasks); a skill already run on a task reuses its stored episode. GEPA runs 20 rounds, so that its batches of 8 cover the 160 training episodes once, and returns the best on dev. SkillOpt makes one pass where upstream makes four, 4 rounds of 40 training tasks (on TB2 under DeepSeek, 5 rounds of 31), and three passes under GPT-6-Luna on TB2, the only run in which its slow update and meta-skill act; the slow update draws its own training tasks and enters the skill without a dev check. It returns the best on dev. SkillAdam takes 16 steps of 10 training tasks (on TB2 under DeepSeek, 18 steps on batches of 9, two of them of 8) and returns the last kept one.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的基线是三个已发表的优化器，各自运行其发布代码（附录 G.1 给出我们填入其提示词的文本）。 每个优化器仅凭成功与否保留或拒绝候选，并根据开发集或训练批次分数返回一个技能，绝不使用测试集（SkillOpt 的上游循环也会在测试集上对三个技能打分；这些分数不用于任何选择）。 三者都按固定顺序从同一样本中获取训练批次，该样本包含 160 个训练回合（在 TB2 上是对 62 个训练任务的三次重新洗牌遍历）；已在某任务上运行过的技能会复用其存储的回合。 GEPA 运行 20 轮，使其每批 8 个的批次恰好覆盖 160 个训练回合一次，并返回开发集上最优的结果。 SkillOpt 上游做四遍，它做一遍，即 4 轮、每轮 40 个训练任务（在 TB2 上用 DeepSeek 时为 5 轮、每轮 31 个），而在 TB2 上用 GPT-6-Luna 时做三遍，这是其慢速更新和元技能发挥作用的唯一一次运行；慢速更新自行抽取训练任务，并在不经过开发集检查的情况下纳入技能。 它返回开发集上最优的结果。 SkillAdam 执行 16 步、每步 10 个训练任务（在 TB2 上用 DeepSeek 时为 18 步、每批 9 个，其中两批为 8 个），并返回最后一个被保留的技能。

paragraphs.en: Of the sixteen learned skills, only GPT-6-Luna’s SkillAdam on AutoBench beats the seed on test by more than the seed’s own run-to-run spread, 6.4 points against 5.8, and the reported dev gains are what selection alone reports, so they do not carry over to test.
paragraphs.zh: 在十六项习得技能中，只有 GPT-6-Luna 的 SkillAdam 在 AutoBench 上于测试集上超过种子（seed）的幅度大于种子自身的运行间波动，即 6.4 分对 5.8 分，而所报告的开发集增益仅仅是选择过程本身所报告的结果，因此并不能延续到测试集上。

paragraphs.en: Most tasks are solved almost always or almost never, so only a few can change a skill’s score from run to run. Each task has a difficulty p v p_{v} , the probability that an episode of the seed solves it, and a benchmark’s difficulties follow a prior Beta ⁡ ( a , b ) \mathrm{Beta}(a,b) fitted by maximum likelihood on the seed’s dev and test episodes; no learned skill’s episode enters the fit. Under DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, ( a , b ) = ( 0.10 , 0.05 ) (a,b)=(0.10,0.05) on TB2, ( 0.55 , 0.19 ) (0.55,0.19) on τ 3 \tau^{3} -bench and ( 0.16 , 0.17 ) (0.16,0.17) on AutoBench, all with a , b < 1 a,b<1 , a prior that puts most tasks near always or never solved. Counted over the seed’s three test runs and its dev runs, two on TB2, three on τ 3 \tau^{3} -bench and two or three on AutoBench, the tasks fall into about the shares this prior expects (Figure 6 ). paragraphs.en: Each replay draws every dev task’s p v p_{v} from its posterior, then one outcome per task for each of K K unchanged candidates, as many as the run scored (5, 4 and 4 for SkillOpt and 8, 7 and 7 for GEPA on TB2, τ 3 \tau^{3} -bench and AutoBench), and applies the optimizer’s acceptance rule. paragraphs.en: Requiring a dev win to repeat refuses most unchanged candidates and keeps most real gains. We compare four rules on the task model, each deciding between one candidate and its parent (Figure 10 a, left to right). Rule (1) accepts a higher score in one dev run each, as SkillOpt and, under DeepSeek, SkillAdam do; it accepts 24, 41 and 39% of unchanged candidates on TB2, τ 3 \tau^{3} -bench and AutoBench. Rule (2) accepts a single-run win only if it reaches the critical value, the smallest margin an unchanged candidate reaches against its parent in at most 5% of draws (2, 5 and 4 tasks); it accepts only 2.7 to 3.2% of unchanged candidates but also only 14 to 21% of true two-task gains on τ 3 \tau^{3} -bench and AutoBench. Rule (3) requires the win to repeat on a second dev run: it accepts 6.4, 17.1 and 15.2% of unchanged candidates and keeps 94, 55 and 62% of true two-task gains. Rule (4), a higher total over three dev runs each, accepts 34 to 45% of unchanged candidates, more than rule (1), because ties are rarer over three runs. Of the 59 DeepSeek edits whose parent the logs identify, the optimizers kept 30, and rule (2) would have refused 29 of the 30; these 29 raised log input tokens by 0.101 on average.
paragraphs.zh: 要求开发胜出必须重复出现，会拒绝大多数未变化的候选，同时保留大多数真实增益。 我们在任务模型上比较四种规则，每种规则在单个候选与其父代之间做出抉择（图 10 a，从左到右）。 规则 (1) 接受各自在单次开发运行中更高的分数，如 SkillOpt 以及在 DeepSeek 下的 SkillAdam 所做的那样；它在 TB2、τ 3 \tau^{3} -bench 和 AutoBench 上接受了 24%、41% 和 39% 的未变化候选。 规则 (2) 仅当单次运行胜出达到临界值时才接受，该临界值是未变化候选在与父代的对局中至多 5% 的抽取次数内所能达到的最小优势（2、5 和 4 个任务）；它仅接受 2.7% 到 3.2% 的未变化候选，但在 τ 3 \tau^{3} -bench 和 AutoBench 上也只保留了 14% 到 21% 的真实双任务增益。 规则 (3) 要求胜出在第二次开发运行中重复出现：它接受 6.4%、17.1% 和 15.2% 的未变化候选，并保留 94%、55% 和 62% 的真实双任务增益。 规则 (4)，即各自在三次开发运行中更高的总分，接受 34% 到 45% 的未变化候选，多于规则 (1)，因为在三次运行中平局更为罕见。 在日志能识别其父代的 59 个 DeepSeek 编辑中，优化器保留了 30 个，而规则 (2) 会拒绝这 30 个中的 29 个；这 29 个编辑平均使日志输入令牌增加了 0.101。

paragraphs.en: SkillOpt on AutoBench re-derives the seed’s verification and adds serialized writes. Three of its rules restate the hand-written seed: a successful response is not proof (the seed’s “verify independently”), read back before claiming completion (its Iron Law), and check a report against the requested fields (its line-by-line requirements check). One has no counterpart in the seed: “perform mutations sequentially”. Behavior splits the same way. Under the hand-written seed, 91.1% of AutoBench episodes follow their last write by a later read, against 53.8% under the three-word seed and 97.2% and 97.8% under the learned skills; but 47.8% of its writes, over all its 360 episodes, still share a turn with another write, against 58.7% under the three-word seed and 4.3% and 1.5% under the learned skills. Serialized writes are the likely source of the 6.1 and 7.2 points by which the learned skills beat the hand-written seed on AutoBench; these single runs cannot separate that rule from the rules added with it.
paragraphs.zh: 在 AutoBench 上运行 SkillOpt 会重新推导出种子提示中的验证机制，并新增串行化写入的规则。 它有三条规则是在复述手写种子提示：成功的响应并不等于证明（对应种子提示的“独立验证”），在声称完成之前先读回结果（对应其铁律），以及对照请求的字段检查报告（对应其逐行需求检查）。 只有一条规则在种子提示中没有对应物：“按顺序执行变更”。 行为表现也以相同的方式划分。 在手写种子提示下，91.1% 的 AutoBench 回合在最后一次写入之后有随后的读取，而在三词种子提示下这一比例为 53.8%，在学到的技能下分别为 97.2% 和 97.8%；但在全部 360 个回合中，其 47.8% 的写入仍与其他写入共享同一轮次，而在三词种子提示下为 58.7%，在学到的技能下分别为 4.3% 和 1.5%。 串行化写入很可能是学到的技能在 AutoBench 上分别以 6.1 和 7.2 个百分点超过手写种子提示的原因；这些单次运行无法把这条规则与随之一起加入的其他规则区分开来。

paragraphs.en: The added rules ask the agent to verify and to act one call at a time, never to read less. We sort each added rule, labeled by keyword search and checked by hand (a second coder agrees at Cohen’s kappa 0.76 on 277 rules), into one of eight categories; four matter here: verify , re-check a result against the request; serialize , act one call at a time; parallelize (under “other” in Figure 12 b), issue independent calls together; and limit reading , read once, read part of an output or keep outputs short. The other four are ask or stop , ask the user, hand off or stop; domain facts , facts about the domain and its tools; format , how to word the answer; and other . The nine DeepSeek skills gain 37 rules on average, from 4 to 105, 337 in all: 52% verify, 18 serialize, one parallelizes reads and none limits reading. Under GPT-6-Luna, 33 of the 38 edits lengthen the skill, and the learned skills add 81 rules: 41% verify, 3 serialize, two parallelize reads and none limits reading.
paragraphs.zh: 新增的规则要求智能体一次只验证并执行一次调用，绝不减少阅读量。 我们对每条新增规则进行分类——通过关键词搜索进行标注并经人工核查（第二位编码者在277条规则上与第一位达成Cohen's kappa 0.76的一致性）——归入八个类别之一；其中有四个在此处相关：验证（verify），即对照请求复核某一结果；串行化（serialize），即一次只执行一次调用；并行化（parallelize，在图12b中归入"其他"），即同时发起相互独立的调用；以及限制阅读（limit reading），即只读一次、只读输出的部分内容或保持输出简短。 其余四类是：询问或停止（ask or stop），即询问用户、移交任务或停止；领域事实（domain facts），即关于该领域及其工具的事实；格式（format），即如何措辞回答；以及其他（other）。 九个DeepSeek技能平均新增37条规则，从4条到105条不等，总计337条：其中52%为验证，18条为串行化，一条并行化读取，没有一条限制阅读。 在GPT-6-Luna下，38次编辑中有33次使技能变长，学习到的技能共新增81条规则：其中41%为验证，3条为串行化，两条并行化读取，没有一条限制阅读。

paragraphs.en: Under the learned skills the agent issues its writes one per turn but still groups its reads. On AutoBench a write is a call that changes state, and a read a GET, a search or a read-only file or shell call, and the rest, such as local file edits, are other calls; OpenCode runs all calls of a turn concurrently. Under the seed, 56% of DeepSeek’s writes share a turn with another write; under each learned skill at most 0.3% do, while the share of reads issued with another read changes by 0.1 to 3.1 points (Figure 14 b). Without any skill the agent groups its writes as the seed does, and under Luna the learned skills also cut the share of writes sharing a turn (for GEPA, on the 61 of 120 tasks with complete logs). Because reads stay grouped, merging consecutive single-read turns would save only about one turn per AutoBench episode.
paragraphs.zh: 在习得技能下，智能体每轮发出一个写操作，但仍会将读操作分组。 在 AutoBench 中，写是改变状态的调用，读是 GET、搜索或只读的文件或 shell 调用，其余调用（如本地文件编辑）为其他调用；OpenCode 并发执行一轮中的所有调用。 在种子技能下，DeepSeek 的写操作有 56% 与另一个写操作共享一轮；在每种习得技能下最多只有 0.3% 如此，而与其他读操作一起发出的读操作占比变化为 0.1 到 3.1 个百分点（图 14 b）。 在没有任何技能时，智能体会像种子技能那样对写操作进行分组，而在 Luna 下，习得的技能同样降低了写操作共享一轮的比例（对于 GEPA，是在 120 个任务中有完整日志的 61 个任务上）。 由于读操作保持分组，合并连续的单读轮次在每个 AutoBench 回合中只能节省大约一轮。

paragraphs.en: Most of that halving is serialized writes, which the rules ask for because each AutoBench write loads, changes and saves the whole simulated world, so two concurrent writes can overwrite each other. Packing only each skill’s writes into turns as densely as the seed does lowers its log turns by about 0.07 and its log ⁡ ρ \log\rho by about 0.08, nearly all that the recomputation removes.
paragraphs.zh: 大部分的减半来自串行化的写入，规则之所以要求串行，是因为 AutoBench 的每次写入都会加载、修改并保存整个模拟世界，因此两个并发写入可能相互覆盖。 如果只把每个技能的写入打包得与种子一样紧凑，会使其日志轮数降低约 0.07，使其 log ⁡ ρ \log\rho 降低约 0.08，几乎等于重计算所移除的全部量。

paragraphs.en: The learned skills sharpen the agent but do not expand it (Figure 16 ). Over six model–benchmark pairs, the seed gains 36 tasks over the no-skill agent and loses 13 (sign test, p = 0.001 p=0.001 ); the learned skills gain 57 over the seed and lose 62, summed over the optimizers (on Luna’s TB2 SkillAdam’s alone, since GEPA and SkillOpt returned the seed).
